Thanks for looping me in. I skimmed Maggie’s notes; high-level legal watchlist:

1) Order Form: ensure that the baseline capacity reclassification references the same SKU identifiers and doesn’t inadvertently create overlap with burst pool credits. Add an explicit "reallocation effective date" and a one-time reconciliation clause.
2) MSA: procurement requested language around invoice timing for prepay. We should preserve standard net-30 but include an optional early-pay discount schedule (if they choose 6/12-month prepay).
3) SOW: confirm acceptance criteria and milestone windows (we’ll tighten wording on cutover acceptance to avoid open-ended signoffs).

I’ll prepare comments in the Order Form redline; Karthik, can you model the two fee ladders and populate the execution_matrix.xlsx? Stephanie, please stand by for uplifted milestone language for the SOW.
